overview: In Sunday Night Fever on RTL 4, Chantal Janzen goes in search of the best protagonist for the musical Saturday Night Fever. In five live shows it must become clear which of the twelve candidates wins.
title: Sunday Night Fever

overview: When the Royal Family decides to accept suitors for the hand of Princess Li Wei, a young thief who calls himself 'Devil Boy' decides to pose as a prince in order to swipe the crown jewels. To his surprise, he ends up genuinely falling in love with the young woman, placing himself and his faithful servant in the crosshairs of the dangerous Prince of the North.
title: Son of the Dragon

overview: Meet Barbara, Els, Toos & Milly... Together they form the perfect circle of friends and live in their home in Scheveningen. The scripts are based on original American screenplays, but have been rewritten into Dutch and the year 2012.
title: Golden Girls

overview: After Li Chu Yao loses her younger brother Chu Chen to an accident, Li Luo Shu, the orphan who lives across the street, takes Chu Chen's place in the Li household to appease his mentally unstable mother. Years pass, and Luo Shu develops romantic feelings for his ‘older sister', though decides to keep them hidden after Chu Yao falls in love with and gets engaged to Han Zi Mo. Unfortunately, Han Zi Mo goes on the run after loan sharks come knocking at his door, and Chu Yao is left with a mountain of debt. Luo Shu is gravely injured while trying to protect her, and Chu Yao eventually realizes who she truly loves. They promise to spend the rest of their lives together, yet are soon forced apart by reality.
title: Yu Chen Tong Guang

overview: Shan Junhao, the CEO of a large hotel chain, meets Ye Tianyu, a schemer, and gold-digger.
title: Wang Ji Ni Ji De Ai Qing

overview: The story is about the romance between a female doctor and a playboy engineering student during the COVID-19 pandemic.
title: Virus Wai Love: Nakrob Chut Kao

overview: Jonah loves animals and he takes us on a journey between the continents where we meet small and large animals from all corners of the world.
title: Jonahs dyreverden

overview: In a small clinic in the Uckermark, the gifted and unusual doctor Amin Ballouz fights for the well-being of his patients and at the same time against his own past. As a young man, he fled his homeland and found a new home in the Uckermark. He has a big heart, always wears a trench coat and drives a Trabi. As a doctor, he practices passionately and does not shy away from unconventional measures. His patients are his family - the hospital is his life. But suddenly he is confronted with the unexpected death of his wife. A short time after the loss, he returned to the clinic. But is he ready for it yet? Those around him try to help him find his way back to life.
title: Doktor Ballouz

overview: Former investigator Sven Hjerson has solved some of the toughest cases in Swedish crime history. Now retired from the limelight, living on the fringes of society, his life mainly consists of daily routines, a vegan diet, vinyl record collecting and an unhealthy appetite for gossip. Klara Sandberg is a reality TV producer living with her partner Niklas and their daughter Olivia. Her career has stagnated and she is looking for something new – is this really all that life has to offer? When she manages to successfully pitch the idea for a new TV show starring Hjerson, it could just be the solution to all of her problems. There's just one snag – she's never actually met Sven Hjerson...
title: Agatha Christie's Hjerson

overview: TOWIE's Pete Wicks and Made in Chelsea's Sam Thompson anchor a reality news series, delivering the latest juicy gossip and breaking stories making the headlines in the reality world.
title: Pete & Sam's Reality News

overview: Xiang Wan wakes up reliving her second year of high school. However, she is no longer the best in class but a loser at the bottom of the barrel. In her desperate sprint back to the top, she gradually reverses her prejudices about others.
title: Don't Disturb My Study

overview: A series about love and cruelty, treachery and all-winning maternal instinct.
title: След саламандры

overview: Auctioneer Angus Ashworth has been running his auction house for more than a decade. With the help of his team and family, he clears out cluttered homes, uncovering hidden gems that he can sell at auction.
title: The Yorkshire Auction House

overview: Don't be deceived by its looks, or you might fall on a trap. This is the untold story of Serpiente.
title: Serpiente

overview: During the Marathon episode of Mooi! weer De Leeuw a Top 12 of Paul's most memorable scenes was made.
title: Paul de Leeuw Top 12

overview: Marta and Věra are employees of the discount portal leeevne.cz but their approach to life is completely different. Marta believes in its work which helps people and loves when everything is in order but is full of illusions. Věra has a strong experience with no illusions and she enjoys to improvise in order to cope with every situation. Brouček (their boss) is a kind of a manager who must manage and spy on everything and everyone like a dictator, so his two employees have a hard time. The characters of the show are thrown into situations where every discount they sell has a catch. For example a ride in a horse chaise without a horse, or a work shift in a mine without a return.
title: Marta a Věra

overview: Divorce is a Dutch drama and is about three very different men between 35 and 45 who are in the middle of divorce and move in together. They share their joys and sorrows, and there is a deep male friendship. The three men are broker Baudouin, director of a fabric store David and handyman George. Their exes, Sophie, Tamar and Joyce are still arranged along with the joint house of lords.
title: Divorce

overview: A 2-part concert. This summer André Rieu and his johann Strauss orchestra gave an open air concert at one of the most beautiful and most romantic squares of The Netherlands, the Vrijthof in Maastricht.
title: Andre Rieu op het Vrijthof

overview: Doctor David Bendricks witnesses a brutal mafia murder during a jogging trip and decides to testify against the killers. A fateful decision, it turns out, when the police are unable to protect his family. Now it remains only for David to take the law into his own hands.
title: En fråga om liv och död

overview: The retired tennis player Pavel Edvardsson has managed to get a wild card for the Swedish Open. When best friend Danne suggests that they take the boat from Stockholm to Båstad the week before the tournament, Pavel can not say no. But parties and other antics make up for Pavel's recharging plans.
title: Stockholm - Båstad

overview: Fragancia is arrested for the attempted murder of Richard Persson, the son of a powerful factory owner. During the interrogation her amazing and remarkable life story is revealed. We follow her through her impoverished childhood, her adolescence where she meets the great love of her life, ice hockey star Petterson-Jonsson and the lead up to the fatal night where the story begins.
title: Kronjuvelerna

overview: 23-year-old Lennart Johansson from Fellingsbro is dark-skinned and wants to become a dance band star, and has Christer Sjögren as his idol. He wants to sing with the dance band Sven Bodins, but does not get in because of his skin color. Sven Bodins claims that there are too many racial prejudices in the dance band genre, but claims that he does not mind dark-skinned dance band singers. Lennart Johansson then decides to start his own dance band.
title: Leende guldbruna ögon

overview: Who is the stronger sex? Man or woman? Bruno Wyndaele thinks it is time to make a decision and therefore makes an appointment for "The Strong Sex". In this program, 2 teams of famous compatriots will compete. Filip Peeters leads the men and Goedele Liekens the women. In each episode, Filip and Goedele choose a theme - for example, adaptability, orientation, intelligence, motor skills, team spirit - and 2 team members to compete. Their game arena is Lesbos, one of the largest Greek islands but unspoiled by mass tourism. The nature is vast, the villages small and life is traditional. The teams choose 3 matches in each episode to illustrate the theme. Are the clichés confirmed? Or can men also multi-task, can women park, do men have a sense of fashion and are women able to find their way? In short, are the men "The Strong Sex"? Or the women?
title: Het sterke geslacht

overview: Twelve well-known Dutch people are looking for a valuable VOC treasure. The participants have to puzzle and search a lot to collect information about the location of the treasure, but also play tactically. Who do you share your information with and with whom do you not? What is your knowledge worth and who can you trust? Every week someone has to go home after the elimination round. Three people eventually play the final, in which the smartest treasure hunter wins 35,000 euros.
title: De schat van de Oranje

overview: In February 1976 it is announced that a senior Dutch government official has taken a bribe from aircraft manufacturer Lockheed. It soon becomes clear that this means Prince Bernhard. The country is in turmoil when it appears that Prince Bernhard has actually accepted a bribe. Juliana threatens to resign. The monarchy is faltering. When senior soldiers start to interfere in solidarity with the Prince and also ask the people for openness, Den Uyl can no longer postpone his decision. Does he choose to preserve the monarchy or not? A political thriller and a royal drama.
title: Den Uyl en de affaire Lockheed

overview: In the four-part documentary series My America, America correspondent Michiel Vos shows what it means to be an American. Like most of his interviewees, Vos is an immigrant. After a ceremony on Ellis Island in 2010 in which he pledged allegiance to the American flag, he was naturalized. In addition to interviews with well-known immigrants (and their children) such as Barack Obama, Henry Kissinger, Arnold Schwarzenegger and fashion queen Diane von Furstenberg, the viewer is introduced to "his" America. Vos' emigrant life seems like a modern American fairytale. One of the reasons he can meet prominent guests is his mother-in-law, Nancy Pelosi, the first female Speaker of the United States House of Representatives and one of America's most influential women. Fox's wife, filmmaker Alexandra Pelosi, provides access to the world of cinema. For example, barbecues in the backyard of the White House and backstage meetings with famous media figures are part of his existence as an immigrant. Yet "The American Dream" is not merely positive. For example, Vos takes a critical look at the American love for weapons and the Iraq war. America as an example, but also as a warning.
title: My America

overview: Dutch drama series about good friends Philip, Tjé, Hein and Mark, who's lives change completely when Philip seemed to be a great poker player and wins an enormous amount of money. As of that moment money doesn't play a part anymore and the friends step into a rollercoaster and make their wildest dreams come true. The online poker talent Julian is the newest member of the group and together they go on adventures full of humor, excitment, friendship and sex.
title: Bluf

overview: The casino is a meeting place of dreams, loves and luck, where anyone can turn: a widowed casino owner who has returned from America and wants to get rid of her husband's legacy at all costs, a step-son who is ready to help with the sale, he knows some underworld figures, a balanced boss who falls in love with the best stuntman in the country, a number mage countess whose nothing escapes his attention, and even a security guard, a taxi driver, a brother and sister, a journalist, a reporter, a lawyer, waitresses, employees, regulars; in a word, many determined players. Here everyone bets and the wheel never stops.
title: Casino

overview: Zhenya really wants to find her female happiness and a good job. She decided to start with the latter. The girl gets the desired job, but there is one risk - falling in love. She is taken to the position of secretary to the son of the head of the company, where her new boss Alexander turns out to be a terrible lazy person.
title: Спасти босса

overview: Copywriter of the years Tuncay, a customer representative eager to become a happy writer, antidepressant addicted agency president Ece and the enthusiastic young employees Burcu and Can together with surprise guests who will take place in each section, we witness the daily crises of an extraordinary agency, its absurd agendas, and its struggles with troubled brands and customers for advertising campaigns.
title: Acans

overview: The successful life of the co-founder of a large advertising agency, Andrey, has everything: an apartment in the city center, and fashionable friends, and a great future in the advertising field. But one day, a nine-year-old child appears on the threshold of his house, claiming that he is his son. Now Andrey has a difficult path ahead: to become a father without giving up his career, and, most importantly, to find the mother of a child from dozens of his former lovers.
title: В активном поиске

overview: Deeds is about a desperate realtor who embarks on an increasingly dark path when she's forced to team up with a drug-addicted, sociopathic, young couple who soon discover that in the world of high-end, LA real estate, when it comes to immorality and cutthroat behavior, they're outmatched.
title: Deeds

overview: Petter Amundsen claims to have found hitherto unknown codes in William Shakespeare's play. The codes say that Shakespeare is not the actual author, but rather a paid front figure in a Masonic project. This Norwegian-produced documentary series in four parts shows how the organist Petter Amundsen from Oslo reveals a treasure map of codes in Shakespeare's literature. The findings lead into a story that includes the Knights Templar and the missing Knights Templar treasure. Dan Brown touches on this in the Da Vinci Code, but Amundsen's story surpasses fiction. It is based on facts that can all be verified. If Petter Amundsen achieves recognition for his theories, the history of literature will have to be rewritten. He will forever stand as the man who solved Shakespeare's great riddle. Should he fail, he will be left as a fanatic in the ranks of naive conspiracy theorists.
title: Shakespeares skjulte koder

overview: The Saturday evening show with Marc-Marie and Beau at SBS 6 makes dreams come true again in a special, funny and emotional way. In the studio show, Marc-Marie Huijbregts and Beau van Erven Dorens will make different dreams of people in the audience come true. No dream is too crazy for Beau and Marc-Marie and of course they do everything in their power to realize the requests in a playful way in the studio.
title: De Zaterdagavondshow met Marc-Marie & Beau

overview: Four small films is a series of TV films in four parts produced by Killinggänget which was shown in the spring of 1999. The black humor they express in these films can be seen as a transition from the light-hearted tone in NileCity 105.6 and Percy Tears to the gravely serious in Four Shades of Brown.
title: Fyra små filmer

overview: Special soldiers Ronny Bratli and Rune Gjeldnes relive the incredible escape story of Jan Baalsrud through North Troms. After the war, the Linge soldier became world famous through the book and film Ni Liv. The escape starts in Toftefjord when a German warship attacks the fishing boat with the sabotage group. Rune and Ronny have to go through the same icy ordeals that Baalsrud barely survived.
title: I Jan Baalsruds fotspor

overview: A young lawyer Javar receives information about taxi fraud in Oslo. Documentation is found on a memory stick he receives from his brother-in-law Ahmad. Javar tips journalist girlfriend Anne, who is also starting to dig into the matter. There are powerful forces they challenge ...
title: Taxi

overview: In his ProSieben show "Schulz in the Box", Olli Schulz asks himself what would have been if he had given his life a different direction. Curious about everything unknown, he lets himself be "kidnapped" from his familiar surroundings: crammed into a wooden box, Olli is shipped to a wide variety of places with very special people and special tasks. The entertainer has to find his way around his new situation without preparation: locked behind bars, immersed in the bizarre hit world, exposed in Tokyo or under the wing of a Russian oligarch - Olli Schulz has to endure a completely foreign life for 24 hours... At the end of the first season, Olli Schulz quit the show and for the second season, various celebrities were instead placed in the box.
title: In the Box

overview: The five single girls in this new program have a number of things in common: they are Brabantian, beautiful, young and they are looking for love. The female singles stay in a luxury villa in sun-drenched Curacao to meet the love of their life. Every episode boys from all over the Netherlands come to stay in the villa. These unbound boys have indicated in advance that they are interested in (one of the) Brabant beauties. The new chicks do not know the boys, but their wishes have been taken into account. What will happen after the chicks get to know their hunks, is this the man of their life or are they going for someone else? The well-spoken babes are in charge throughout the series. They decide which guy they want to share their own double room with. At the end of each episode, the girls are faced with a choice: will they go for love or will they stay on Curacao? The villa must be left immediately if love is chosen. On the mat, another new chick from Brabant is ready to enter the villa.
title: New Chicks: Brabantse nachten op Curaçao

overview: As with the great "Saturday Night Live" model, a different prominent guest should greet the audience every week. Afterwards there will be films, skits and live performances by the ensemble, in which topics and events related to the celebrity guest are told over and over again.
title: Die unwahrscheinlichen Ereignisse im Leben von...

overview: Two weeks after Norway was attacked in April 1940, the Norwegians fought a desperate battle against the world's largest military force in anticipation of Allied aid.
title: Alliert og alene

overview: The romantic crime series Hart tegen Hard revolves around Detective Thomas and crime journalist Ava. In their work, the two are confronted with kidnapping, assault and theft, but above all with each other. Deep in their hearts they want nothing more than to be together, but their work makes that almost impossible. They have to do everything they can to keep the desire a secret, especially from each other. The cast includes Elise Schaap, Dragan Bakema, Huub Stapel, Renee Fokker and Barry Atsma.
title: Hart tegen Hard

overview: Amalies jul is a Norwegian Advent calendar for children. Can the Santa cub manage enough pixie tricks and pixie joys before the big test at Månetoppen? And will there be human beings in the big house?
title: Amalies jul

overview: Latela follows everyday life of a group of car enthusiasts.
title: Latela

overview: Merperson Yang Luo Tian has always gone as a boy for most of his life. That is until he saved Lie Heng Yu from drowning. When a merperson first falls in love, the equivalent of puberty hits and their body begins to take on one gender. Yang Luo Tian finds his body and mind slowly turning female. To avoid scrutiny over her sudden changes, she switches colleges, only to still pose as a man after being recognized by her childhood friend. She soon ends up roommates with Lie Heng Yu. As if it's not hard enough hiding her gender from him, she also has to hide the fact that she cries pearls and her scales flare up when her skin touches the water.
title: The Rules of Love

overview: The drama is based on a manhwa with the same title. Tamna the Island is set in 17th-century Joseon times as a young English castaway, William, comes to the island and meets Jang Beo Jin, Park Kyu, and Yan. The name "Tamna" refers to what is now called Jeju. The show started with low viewership, so the network wanted to cut it short to move on to other dramas. They trimmed and compressed arcs, which hurt the flow. Later, because the show gained a cult following (especially overseas), the full 21-episode version was released on DVD and internationally which contains full intended story with a different ending.
title: Tamra, the Island

overview: A drama about an adopted woman who struggles to make a family.
title: The Birth of a Family

overview: Racers have proven they're willing to do whatever it takes to become the drivers who can go down any road, anywhere, anytime. And for the first time ever, racers from OKC, Memphis, Texas, NOLA, Detroit, Cali and everywhere in between will be ranked on a single list compiled of the best, baddest and fastest racers in the nation.
title: Street Outlaws: America's List

overview: 60 Minutes+ is an exclusive new program on Paramount+ from '60 MINUTES', the most successful television news broadcast in history. The show is tailored for a growing younger audience, and offers hard-hitting investigative reports, feature segments, and profiles of people in the news in short documentary-style segments. Correspondents include Enrique Acevedo, Wesley Lowery, Laurie Segall, and Seth Doane.
title: 60 Minutes Plus

overview: Aaf is the head of the ultimate middle class family. The family consisting of mother Aaf, father Ton and children Marie and Jozefien, and little Bennie. The familiarity of the everyday concerns, the marriage with the corresponding family, eternal battle over the household and the family love that holds everything together, are central in this brand new RTL 4 - series.
title: Aaf
Mon gâteau est le meilleur de France

overview: In this show, Bridget Maasland experiences what it takes to become a mom. In her own way she literally experiences what it is like to become a mother. You can see how she plunges into the wonderful world of pickles, pregnancy courses, ultrasounds, maternity clothes, chic baby showers and all the baby must-haves that a mom-to-be can buy.
title: Hoe word ik mama in Amsterdam-Zuid?

overview: No one is sure when the prank masters from Youtube, Random Making Movies, take the step over to Kanal 5 with their very own comedy program that mixes pranks, sketches and interviews in true RMM spirit.
title: Käftsmäll med Random Making Movies

overview: In each episode Paul De Leeuw receives a second class from a secondary school. He determines the theme of the broadcast and discusses this theme. The students also show a home-made photo report and there are live performances by artists. In short film sketches, De Leeuw can lose his comical egg. Every now and then you even catch a glimpse of future characters and his, sometimes cruel, sense of humor.
title: De 10 over half vijf Paul de Leeuw show

overview: Nongrarm is a stressed, jealous and bored middle-aged woman who falls in love with her niece's lover, but that love turns into obsession.
title: Rai Sanaeha

overview: This is a story about people fighting for better lives and looking for opportunities in a big city. Praew and Pangkwan suddenly lost their sister because she was the victim of a hit and run by Purich. Payu got involved in this situation as he's trying to settle everything out for his brother and the victim's family. Pangkwan needs to start working in a Northeastern Food Restaurant because of her sister's death and the restaurant owner happened to be her ex-boyfriend, Dandin. However, the troublesome situation is not over yet, as Purich wants to take the restaurant away from these people. Payu does not like the idea and teams up with Praew to stop Purich and destroy his plan in every way. Will they be able to win the battle with an evil capitalist like Purich or not?
title: Crowns of Grass

overview: Karnkaew, a girl studying in the province Bangkok. She can upgrade herself to a higher class when she gets an income as a courtesan. Her best friend is Chala, an unambitious girl who works as waitress to paid her credit fee. Karnkaew goes out with Gunchorn, a teacher who teaches at that school. Meanwhile she flirts with Arwut, her boss at the company, but she decides to break off with both of them, because she's wants to live a luxurious life and both Gunchorn and Arwut can't afford these things for her. So she needs to find new man who can give her a luxurious life.
title: Lhong Fai

overview: Former bride and forever comedian Jamie Lee shares her irreverent yet practical tips and tricks for wedding planning with struggling lovebirds.
title: The Wedding Coach

overview: In this Dutch police detective series, Detective Jurriaan 'Jurre' de Cock is the 'Columbo' of a Dutch city's police department.
title: Baantjer

overview: One day, Nobuo Harada starts work as a Japanese language teacher at a high school. He is gay and dresses like a woman. He sympathizes with the lives and worries of his students.
title: My Skirt, Where Did It Go?

overview: 38-year-old Matsumoto Chiaki is divorced and single. Because she married early at the age of 24, she has not had much experience with men. When she starts thinking of regaining the youth that she had lost, she is recommended a matching making app by her good friend Rika. Chiaki checks the app out of curiosity and discovers it is full of handsome younger men who do not care for age difference. She keeps going on wholesome dates with these young men. But one morning when Chiaki wakes up, she finds her clothes strewn around and a university student lying next to her
title: The Diary of the 38-year-old Divorcee who has tried a Dating App

overview: Onda Kokoro is an oncologist called Dr Onkoro for short by the people around her and teased that she was born for this path. She got married to Takumi, whom she had known since she was a student, and they had a son. Life was going smoothly for her. But three months ago, her husband fell in an accident and remained unconsciousness even though he underwent emergency surgery. Although Kokoro puts on a brave face at work, she still has not been able to accept reality. One day, she meets Kajiyama Kaoru, a competent gastroenterologist who has transferred to work at the hospital. Kaoru understands the need for oncology as a surgeon and gives emotional support with her sunny personality as a colleague. She becomes a dear friend whom Kokoro feels is sudden a ray of light in her personal and professional life…
title: Alive: Dr. Kokoro, The Medical Oncologist

overview: Oleg, who lives at high speeds, is used to the fact that the whole house rests on his wife. But she suddenly leaves and leaves the hero alone. How will a rock 'n' roll father cope with the household and raising three daughters?
title: Олег

overview: Koharu is a dull high school girl who is always alone. Her only hobby is making plastic models. One day, Koharu stops by a mysterious antique shop and purchases a plastic model gun and a toy figure named Alice. After spending the entire night assembling the gun, Koharu wakes up and witnesses bullets flying everywhere in school. She then meets Alice who moves like a human and tells her to get ready for a survival battle called "Girl Gun Fight", where she has to attack her schoolmates with a gun.
title: Girl Gun Lady

overview: Two NYPD Cops who never shut up debate mundane topics such as coffee, cologne, and who's got a gluten allergy.
title: Midtown

overview: Directed by Joshua Zeman, the series revisits the infamous string of murders that shook New York City in the late Seventies but also explores the argument that David Berkowitz wasn't a lone killer. To that end, the series delves into the work of journalist Maury Terry, who became convinced Berkowitz hadn't acted alone and spent decades trying to prove it.
title: The Sons of Sam: A Descent into Darkness

overview: The series is about the lives of several different families who are bonded together in different ways in the fictional town Solbekk. The title of the series reflects the name of a club in which most of the women in the series takes part.
title: Familiesagaen De syv søstre

overview: The series is following four total different football wives in a rich neighbourhood of Amsterdam. All four are wrung, each one on their own, by impossible drama's, personal issues and the life of their husband.
title: Voetbalvrouwen

overview: When Nature Calls with Helen Mirren is a laugh-out-loud, one-hour unscripted comedy series which looks at the lighter side of the natural world.
title: When Nature Calls with Helen Mirren

overview: Have you still remembered your friends in "The Yearbook"? A series that will bring you back to the early 2000 and the deep connection between Phob and Nut. When the two of them promised to follow their dreams together. Unfortunately, someone didn't keep the promise and that led to disagreement. There was only pain left between them. Finally, they were apart. Four years later, the yearbook brings that one friend comes back again with some truths. At the end, their friendship, intimacy, and dreams will return again or they have to face the the reality and left everything as memories in the Yearbook.
title: The Yearbook

overview: The main character, the "Eternal Stenz", is the 50-year-old Munich detective and bon vivant Franz Münchinger. Münchinger, lives happily with his wife Annette von Soettingen in Munich-Schwabing. He loves his city and he loves his wife Annette, whom he affectionately calls "Spatzl". And Annette loves Monaco, even if she comes from much better circles than him. But Monaco also loves adventure. He has a burning interest in the female sex and he also maintains more or less stable relationships with other women, which Annette is well aware of. His best friend Manfred "Manni" Kopfeck, who, like Münchinger, works as a detective commissioner for the Munich police, regularly helps him initiate these affairs and hide them from his wife in an amusing way. Monaco's wife Annette runs an antiques shop and - according to her parentage - is in the so-called better society, with which Monaco can only partially identify. This contrast often leads to humorous situations, for example when Monaco tries to avoid going to the opera.
title: Monaco Franze - Der ewige Stenz

overview: Three candidates unknown to each other must make as much money as possible. After a question round the candidates must try divide to the money mutually, but not everyone can get the same amount of money. How long the candidates take agreeing the money split, the less money remains. The candidates must therefore come to a decision who gets what amount. The quiz has multiple choice questions of general knowledge, but also of human nature, conviction strength, calm and speed. Who is a born leader, has the best arguments and keeps his/her cool?
title: BankGiro Loterij: De gemene deler

overview: For half a year, journalists from NRK followed the Norwegian soldiers in Afghanistan. We follow the soldiers of the Norwegian camp in Meymaneh in Faryabprovinsen.
title: Norge i krig - oppdrag Afghanistan

overview: The series depicted the everyday life of Helene Rask and seven glamor models in her agency, Rask Models.
title: Glamourjentene

overview: In all cultures, colors have been used in a symbolic sense, and have always been attributed certain characteristics. The colors know no bounds, and hide many stories. Torkjell Berulfsen and Rolf Larsen have traveled the world to find these stories. The result is this TV series.
title: Berulfsens Fargerike

overview: Eight fat guys have gathered for pranks and fun in Gran Canaria to find out which of them will return to the motherland with the title of the fattest guy of the year. What do you think happens if you take four party-happy guys from the village and four equally party-happy guys from Oslo, and gather them for light-hearted competitions and challenges in the south? Yes, then you will find out who is the fattest guy of the year! In this web series, you will become better acquainted with an unbridled group of boys on a boy's trip to Gran Canaria. Every day, they will compete in the least intelligent challenges and unscrupulous tasks imaginable, where the winner gets honor and glory, while the losers are punished. It's hard and brutal in true Jackass style, and bruises, vomiting and roars of laughter sit loose. To win the title, they must prove that they are the most playful, street-smart and daring guy on Playa del Ingles. Together they will bring the most shame and some pride in their gender. This is necessary when we on TV3 play nominate the fattest guy of the year!
title: Årets Feteste Fyr

overview: In TV3's new TV series Bygg & Bedrag, people who have fallen victim to rogue tradesmen will be helped to solve their problems. Host Janne Seime Siler has ten years of experience in consumer journalism, and she is not afraid to confront dishonest tradesmen. In addition, TV3's team of experts and partners will ensure that the refurbishment is carried out professionally.
title: Bygg Og Bedrag

overview: Razor-sharp comedy drama that takes a wry look at the people and politics of London's police force.
title: Babylon

overview: In her new program, medium Gro-Helen Tørum will travel around to people who carry a strong desire to get in touch with a friend or relative who has passed away. She will act as a link between our world and the other side, so that people can convey what they have in mind or ask questions.
title: Fra sjel til sjel

overview: Hit og dit is a travel program with a clear consumer profile. Each program contains a total of three reports, and the main journey itself is by Kjersti Idem. It means a life in a suitcase in the time ahead. Over the next few months, she will visit Greece, the Maldives, Panama and Japan, among other places. - The show is a consumer-friendly program, with everything from how to prepare before you travel, to skin tips in the sun and other practical things along the way.
title: Hit og Dit

overview: This 6-part drama series focuses on Ellie's not-as-it-seems perfect life. Ellie seems to have it all – the perfect husband, daughter and close-knit group of friends. The unbreakable gang are all in their mid-thirties. They depend on each other, they're a family. But what happens when tragedy strikes and unleashes demons in Ellie that threaten the façade of her life and even the core of her sanity.
title: Bregus

overview: Tohn is a first-year college student who loves playing basketball and dreams of becoming a high-level player. Although he is committed to success, he is reunited with Tupfah, an older former basketball player whom he used to know, and who has now put his own sporting ambitions on ice. Tohn feels attracted to Tupfah, but is unsure about whether or not he should tell Tupfah about his feelings or not, worried that doing so might cause problems. But as they spend more time together, a bond of friendship develops as Tohn tries to convince the older student to return to the sport – but could this all end up turning into love? However, their hearts – and sporting hopes – are not the only ones on the line. Aii is hoping to win a scholarship to study abroad. To do so, he will need to secure high grades at college. But although he does want to gain a place at a Japanese university, his head is turned by a football player with dazzling good looks, threatening to divert his focus away from his school work. Meanwhile, two relay team track runners find themselves attracted to one another – despite the fact that one is dating the other's sister!
title: You're My Sky

overview: Puncha is an investigator and met Dunchaya who happens to be the suspect in poisoning a victim by being the one who made the food. Because of fear, she ran away and Puncha chased her. They were in a boat and strange things happen leading them to two crossed back to 1913. Puncha had to temporarily stop investigations into the case of Dunchaya, and they were looking for a way back together, but the two were accidentally involved in a murder case. Looking for a way to get back from the present time, the two investigated the case but the matter was not as simple as the leads thought, many killed in a row and they have to find who is doing it.
title: Kadee Rak Kham Pop

overview: Phaya Yen is a mysterious jungle where many bandits assembled. This place has a story: in the deepest parts of the jungle, there's a deserted town where is full of golden treasure hidden named ‘Kwangtaburi'. Up until now, no one steps inside due to fear of mystery, fierce creatures and wicked bandits. And so the adventure story of Petch Phayaprai began. He came here just to seek for his father who got lost in this jungle and never returned. He studied the route to get inside and believed that his father might have gotten lost somewhere in Kwangtaburi. There he met a mysterious lady Sroi and grandmother Thong (who hid the secret that she could turn into a magic tiger), and saved them from their opponents. Petch later took them back to the village, without knowing that they were not just ordinary people. Robbery cases happened day by day in Phaya Yen jungle, making this place very dangerous. Deputy Jerd was assigned to beat all bandits but he got spelled by a creature and disappeared, leading to his arrogant daughter Chan and her fiancé Tadthep came to find him. They asked many guides to lead the way into the jungle but only Petch agreed to do this task, with the goal to find his own father as well. Along the journey, Chan found out that Petch was strong and dependable so she fell for him, and even treated Tadthep poorly. However, Petch loved Sroi whom he did not know was princess Sroisuda-dhevi of Kwangtaburi who escaped from the gangster of Garong. What will Petch decide when he finds out the true identity of Sroi? And will he defeat all the obstacles and save his father?
title: Dong Phaya Yen

overview: Ailada is a sweet-hardworking woman; who runs an online clothing sales page with her friend Sushi. Ailada lives together with her boyfriend, Fin, A salesman whose parents passed away when he was a child. The couple has financial problems, and Ailada is the sole contributor to paying the rent for the house and the utility bills. One day while working, Fin runs into one of his friends that suggests to him a company that can make him so-called "rich" and makes money easily. Fin tells Alida about the offer but she finds the whole situation sketchy and rejects the proposition. Frustrated by Alida response and his inferiority complex of not being able to provide, Fin gets into an argument with her. While being overwhelmed with stress, Ailada goes to Facebook and comes across Venus; a public figure that can supposedly help people with wealth and happiness, by giving advice to others and holding classes. Ailada then starts to think about the goals she wants to set and reach in the future. The next morning, desperate Ailada goes to meet Venus for help. Will Ailada get the desired advice she's always been wanting to hear? Will Ailada get to finally do the things that make her happy while living a stable life?
title: Life Coach

overview: Wanthong was brought to trial as people condemned her for being in a love triangle and could not choose who to be her husband between "Khun Paen" and "Khun Chang". The king ordered her to choose but she refused to do so, then Wanthong began telling her story to the king. 17 years ago, Wanthong was in love with Khun Paen and they lived together. However, Khun Chang who secretly loved Wanthong tricked her that Khun Paen was killed and made her be his own. When Khun Paen returned victoriously, he found that Wanthong had become Khun Chang's wife and was angry. Meanwhile, Wanthong became heartbroken as Khun Paen brought back another wife. She nonetheless forgave Khun Paen and wanted to be with him again by using Khun Chang as a tool. Khun Chang was mad and confined her in a room. He then planned to get rid of Khun Paen but Khun Paen noticed his evil scheme and therefore traveled to find a magic item to get Wanthong back. Between the man she loved but was not one-girl kind of a guy, and the man who only loved her but treated her like an object…Who would Wanthong choose in the end?
title: Wanthong
